correctness.rationale:
Verified every essential inference. Lemma 1 (left ideal => circle-subgroup, Damele Prop 2.1): h circ k = h+lambda_h(k) in H and circ-inverse lambda_h^{-1}(-h) in H via lambda-homomorphism; sound. Lemma 2 Sylow counting n_p in {1,q}, n_q in {1,p,p^2} with congruences; sound. Lemma 3 (characteristic Sylow is ideal, Acri Lemma 2.1 mechanism): char in (B,+) gives lambda-invariance and +-normality, hence left ideal, hence by Lemma 1 a circle-subgroup of Sylow order, hence unique Sylow of (B,circ) and normal there; application is correct because uniqueness in every group of order p^2q is proved simultaneously in each case. Case q>p: ruled out n_q=p (needs q|p-1, impossible as 0 p+1 even >2 while q odd prime). Hence n_q=1, unique Sylow-q char in + is order-q ideal. Case q q|p+1 forces q|(p+1)/2

p+1=2m, odd divisor divides m), so in q

originality.rationale: Headline audited is the disproof: no ideal-simple skew brace of order p^2q for distinct odd p,q (with stated minimal ideals), hence no odd boundary witness with q|p+1 and target conjunction false. Live retrieval with three normalized forms (literal no-simple statement; equivalent/encoding forms with skew/left brace, holomorph regular subgroup, Sylow characteristic ideal/socle language, Acri/Bonatto/Damele/Byott/SmallSkewBraces leads; dominance/census forms for stronger theorems and databases) returned 20 fused results, coverage ok on all providers with no partial failure (serpbase 10+10+10, crossref 15+15+15, openalex 15+0+0, partial=false). Screened snippets/metadata and fetched Acri I (2004.04291), Acri II (2004.04232), Damele (2607.17125), Byott (2405.16154) primaries in full (abstract+HTML). No prior states or implies the universal odd non-existence. See decisive_checks for adversarial checklist. Timestamp/failed search not used for priority; comparison is substantive.

residual_risks: Damele arXiv:2607.17125 is very recent (July 2026); future versions could approach the odd-p^2q window more closely, but v2 fetched in full does not imply it for the stated reason (non-cyclic C_p^2 smallest Sylow).
Group-theoretic Sylow uniqueness at odd order p^2q is folklore/elementary; novelty lies in the brace-ideal synthesis and sharpness refutation, not in group counting alone.
Vacuous truth of the rigidity clause is classical-logic; audit distinguishes it from the false sharpness conjunction, as does DRAFT.

If sharpness were reinterpreted to allow p=2, order-12 simples (3|2+1) would witness sharpness of q|p+1 with oddness dropped; the audited admitted sense (odd-p^2q witness, cf. admission review that order-12 is p=2 excluded and Byott family is p^p q) remains impossible, and DRAFT explicitly isolates oddness as essential.
